decisions.rationale: Tailwind v4 JIT scans source files for complete class name strings at build time. Dynamically-constructed names are invisible to the scanner and produce no CSS output. Especially critical with custom @theme tokens that have no fallback.

decisions.decision: Reactive lookup pattern for Svelte 5 template-level computed values
decisions.choice: Use `$derived` instead of `{@const}` for reactive Record lookups in component top-level template
decisions.rationale: Svelte 5 restricts `{@const}` to block contexts ({#if}, {#each}, etc.) — it cannot be used at top-level template scope. `$derived` achieves the same D016-safe result (full static class string via Record lookup) while being reactive and valid at any scope level.

decisions.choice: Maestro CLI (`maestro hierarchy --device`) as default, with APK (device-server) and native (adb/idb) as switchable alternatives
decisions.rationale: Maestro's hierarchy parser differs from raw UiAutomator — showing Maestro's view by default ensures selectors in flows match what the user sees during inspection

decisions.choice: SVG over screenshot (not Canvas)
decisions.rationale: SVG gives free hover/click events on elements; hierarchy trees rarely exceed ~500 visible elements, so perf is fine. Canvas would require manual hit-testing.
decisions.revisable: Yes — if perf becomes an issue with very deep trees

decisions.choice: Out of scope for M003
decisions.rationale: User explicitly deferred tap/swipe/type from browser. Inspector is read-only.

decisions.choice: Two-click inline pattern (first click shows Yes/No confirmation replacing action buttons) instead of modal dialog
decisions.rationale: Inline confirmation keeps the user's attention on the item being deleted without a disruptive modal overlay. HookList passes deleteConfirm state from parent to control which row is in confirmation mode. Simpler than a shared modal component and consistent with the dense, information-first UI philosophy (D004/D007).

decisions.choice: Appium used only for hierarchy fetching (getPageSource), NOT for test execution
decisions.rationale: User explicitly stated Maestro remains the sole test executor. Appium provides a 4th hierarchy source — better than raw adb uiautomator dump because Appium maintains a persistent UiAutomator2 server on device, and supports iOS via XCUITest driver.
